dark.prompt: Material: near-black lacquered surfaces ({panel}, raised {panelRaised}) rimmed with bright gold ({panelEdge}, highlights {goldLight}); garnet enamel accents ({gem}, lit {gemLight}).

parchment.prompt: Material: aged parchment ({surface}, shadowed {background}, light {surfaceAlt}), sepia ink ({text}), antique gold and brass ({accent}, {border}), garnet accents ({gem}, shadow {gemShadow}).

scene.prompt: Painted illustration, full bleed. Keep the darkest values near {panel}, the warm highlights toward {panelEdge} and any banner cloth toward {gem}, so that dark gold-rimmed panels sit naturally on top.

neutral.prompt: Material: pure greyscale with alpha only, no hue whatsoever: the game tints it.

prompt.style: Game UI asset for a painted dark-fantasy tactical RPG, in the style of a richly illustrated tabletop sourcebook: relief gold and brass filigree, worn enamel, soft light from the top left, fine painterly grain. Front orthographic view, perfectly centred and symmetrical unless stated, no perspective, no cast shadow outside the piece.
prompt.noLettering: Absolutely no lettering, letters, numbers, runes or glyphs anywhere: the game sets all text itself in {titleFamily} (titles) and {bodyFamily} (body).
prompt.lettering: The only lettering allowed is the one described below, in carved Roman capitals in the spirit of {titleFamily}; no other text.
prompt.three-slice: Horizontal 3-slice piece: the end ornaments lie inside {left} px from the left and {right} px from the right; the section between them is uniform and repeats seamlessly along the width; the full height is kept as drawn.
prompt.nine-patch: 9-patch piece: every corner ornament lies inside {left} px from the left, {right} px from the right, {top} px from the top and {bottom} px from the bottom; between them the edges are uniform and repeat seamlessly, and the centre is plain and seamlessly repeatable.
prompt.fixed: Fixed-size piece, never stretched: keep a 4 px empty margin around it.
prompt.tile: Seamlessly tileable in both directions, no visible seam, no focal feature.
prompt.cover: Full-screen background, composed for 16:9, safe to crop 10 % on either side.

pieces.name: Scène du menu et des crédits
pieces.description: Vallée au couchant, cité fortifiée au centre-droit, compagnie de quatre aventuriers de dos sur un promontoire à droite, étendard grenat à gauche. Le tiers gauche reste calme et sombre : la colonne du menu et le logo s'y posent.
pieces.prompt: Epic painted landscape at golden-hour sunset: a river valley with a walled castle city on a hill centre-right, misty mountains, dramatic clouds; four adventurers seen from behind on a rocky outcrop in the right third (archer, armoured warrior, fur-clad dwarf, hooded mage with a glowing staff), a campfire and lantern at the bottom right. The left third is darker and quiet, with a tall garnet war standard at the far left edge, leaving room for a menu column.
